11 tools

Three steps. Zero setup.

No install, no account, no upload — just a seed and a canvas.

01

Enter a seed

Type any world seed, or hit the dice for a random one. The map rebuilds instantly.

02

Toggle what you need

Biomes, structures, slime chunks and the chunk grid are all independent layers.

03

Copy the coordinates

Tap or hover a pin for x/z and one-click /tp. Done — go find it in game.

World overview

Explore your world

Swipe anywhere to scroll the page. To drag or pinch the map, tap Move map; tap it again to return to page scrolling. You can also use the + and − buttons.

Explore farther: Use Layers → Go to coordinates. Choose your teleport Y there. Structure locations are predictions; Bedrock results are experimental.
